workflow.name: Daily Stock Monitor with AI Summary Email
workflow.description: Scrapes Financial Times via Bright Data for top 10 US stocks, saves results to Google Sheets, aggregates data, generates an AI-powered HTML summary email, and sends it via Gmail.

API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for LLM calls

MODEL.description: Model name for AI summary generation

workflow_steps.name: get_sample_data
workflow_steps.description: Provide the list of top 10 US stocks to track

workflow_steps.name: split_and_set_keywords
workflow_steps.description: Split stock array into individual items and extract ticker as keyword

workflow_steps.name: scrape_financial_times
workflow_steps.description: Trigger Bright Data Financial Times scraper for all stock keywords (mock)

workflow_steps.name: get_scraping_progress
workflow_steps.description: Check scraping progress status - polls until ready (mock: always ready)

workflow_steps.name: get_snapshot_data
workflow_steps.description: Retrieve scraped data from Bright Data snapshots (mock)

workflow_steps.name: save_to_sheets
workflow_steps.description: Save scraped stock data to Google Sheets (mock: local JSON)

workflow_steps.name: aggregate_data
workflow_steps.description: Aggregate all scraped stock items into a single data object
